newsitem.title: FRANCE: PERNOD H1 SALES UP 10.4 PERCENT.
newsitem.headline: PERNOD H1 SALES UP 10.4 PERCENT.

text.p: (All figures in millions of French francs)
NOTE - Pernod-Ricard gave its sales figures in a statement. It gave no comparative figure.

It said growth was particularly strong during the second quarter of 1997. It said 68 percent of turnover came from outside of France during the first half compared with 61 percent during the comparable 1996 period.

Sales outside of France grew 23.4 percent, while sales within France fell 10.1 percent, hurt by the effects of heavy buying by large distributors in late 1996, ahead of an anticipated increase in the tax on spirits.
